div.head: II Cn 78
div.ab: And se man, þe on þam fyrdunge ætforan his hlaforde fealle, si hit innan lande, si hit of lande, beon ða heregeata forgyfene; ⁊ fon þa erfenuman to lande ⁊ to æhtan ⁊ scyftan hit swyðe rihte.
⁊ se man þe on þam fyrdunge ætforan his hlaforde fealle, sy hit innan lande, sy hit of lande, beon þa heregeata forgyfene; ⁊ fon þa yrfenuman to lande ⁊ to æhtan ⁊ scyftan hit swiðe rihte.
Et qui in bello ante dominum suum ceciderit, sit hoc in terra sit alibi: sint releuationes condonatę; et habeant heredes eius terram et pecuniam eius (suam) et recte diuidant inter se.

Be ðam ðe toforan his laforde fealleð. And se man ðe on fyrdunge ætforan his hlaforde fealle, sy hit innon lande, sy hit ut of lande, beon ða heregeata forgyfene, ⁊ fon ða yrfenuman to lande ⁊ to æhte ⁊ scyften hit swiðe rihte.
And se man, þe on þam fyrdunge ætforan his hlaforde fealle, si hit innan lande, si hit of lande, beon ða heregeata forgyfene; and fon þa erfenuman to lande and to æhtan and scyftan hit swyðe rihte.

Concerning the man who falls before his lord. And the heriots of the man who falls before his lord during a campaign, whether within the country or abroad, shall be remitted, and the heirs shall succeed to his land and his property and make a very just division of the same.
And the tributes of a man who falls before his lord during a campaign, whether at home or abroad, shall be returned; and his heirs shall receive his land and possessions and share them most fairly.

And the heriot is to be remitted for the man who falls before his lord in a campaign, whether it is within the land or outside the land; and the heirs are to succeed to the land and to the possessions and divide it very justly.

(Von dem der im Angesicht seines Herrn fällt. B) Und der Mann, der im Kriegszuge fällt in Gegenwart seines Herrn, sei es im Land, sei es fern vom Land: seien die Heergewæte [seinen Erben] erlassen; und mögen die Erbnehmer Land und Fahrhabe ergreifen und es sehr rechtlich theilen.

(Of him who falls in his lord's presence. B) And the man who falls on campaign in the presence of his lord, whether in the land or away from the land: let the heriots be remitted [to his heirs]; and let the heirs take the land and movable goods and divide it very justly.
div.note: B adds rubric Be ðam ðe toforan his laforde fealleð
